mentions.name: Chalkolate
mentions.description: Browser-based learning games that help young children explore and understand small concepts through tiny games. Topics are chosen based on the author's daughter's learning needs and her own ideas, and new content introducing basic electronics is currently in development.
mentions.problem: Young children need engaging ways to explore and understand small concepts, tailored to what they could improve.
